speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Given your 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, I need to quickly assess your hydration and neurological status. Are you able to swallow liquids without choking, and have you noticed any new weakness or confusion regarding recent events? Also, have you had any recent travel, insect bites, or contact with sick animals?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of tics and haloperidol use, is the altered mentation a new onset or a change in your baseline, and when was your last dose of medication? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Blood_Culture.

speaker: Doctor
text: With your blood work normal and no focal neurological deficits, are you currently experiencing any hallucinations or delusions, and has anyone witnessed a generalized seizure? REQUEST TEST: Urine_Analysis, Blood_Ammonia, Serum_Anti-NMDA_Receptor_Ab.

speaker: Doctor
text:
With all your initial labs and the anti-NMDA receptor antibodies being normal, can you describe exactly what your confusion consists of, and has anyone observed any repetitive, purposeless movements or posturing since your symptoms started?

REQUEST TEST: CT_Head, Serum_Electrolytes, Toxicology_Screen.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)
